messages.content: Repair exactly one story-arc allocation error. Return JSON only.

SOURCE STORY
Amy is at home cooking breakfast for Will and Amber.
A zombie breaks the kitchen door window. Amy sees the danger, rushes the kids to the basement, gets them inside, and locks the door.
Amy retrieves a pistol and katana and equips them.
The majority of the film is Amy killing, dismembering, and decapitating zombies as they attack.
Amy kills the last zombie, the house now soaked in blood, then lets the kids out.

CURRENT EVENTS
1. breakfast
2. zombie breaks window
3. kids rushed into basement and door locked
4. retrieve pistol and katana
5. equip weapons
6. kill a zombie
7. kill last zombies; house blood soaked
8. let kids out

VALIDATOR ISSUE
Only 2/8 beats are in the zombie-fighting sequence; at least 5/8 are required.

REPAIR
Keep Beat 1 as breakfast. Fit all other pre-fight setup into Beats 2-3. Beats 4-8 must all materially belong to zombie fighting. Beat 8 combines the terminal zombie kill, blood-soaked result, and letting the kids out. Preserve source order. Exactly one event per beat.

Return exactly:
{"events":[{"id":"E1","event":"...","beat_number":1,"depends_on":[]},...,{"id":"E8","event":"...","beat_number":8,"depends_on":["E7"]}]}
